title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 347 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

EUV views show a broad dark coronal-hole-like region and several bright active regions, with no obvious large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
